data.description:
## Description
**What**: Extend /dso:retro with a Graduation Phase where an opus sub-agent reads all negative-example bugs without a promoted-to-standard:* tag via a single CLI query and identifies candidates via (a) frequency floor (>=3 examples same bug_type_slug with distinct root-cause fingerprints, collapsing groups with >=80% missed_signal_summary similarity to one signal) and (b) cross-slug semantic match via a single falsifiable predicate naming a specific input state/code path AND expected observable outcome (theme-level labels rejected). Each candidate is surfaced with a 4-field draft rule, >=3 evidence_citations with quoted missed_signal_summary, and explicit provenance. A PRE-DRAFT validation checks existing behavioral-testing-standard.md rules and blocks surfacing on unresolved overlap. A SYCOPHANCY GATE on user acceptance requires a non-empty, non-restating answer to the distinct-coverage challenge before PR drafting, else marks the candidate challenged-rejected. Emits structured RETRO_TELEMETRY whose examples_extracted_since_last_retro and examples_skipped_count counters use a since-last-retro watermark.
**Why**: This is the promotion engine that turns accumulated examples into rule candidates.
**Scope**:
- IN: Graduation Phase logic; single CLI query; frequency-floor trigger + collapse; cross-slug falsifiable-predicate trigger; 4-field draft + evidence_citations + provenance; pre-draft conflict check; sycophancy gate; since-last-retro watermark; RETRO_TELEMETRY emission.
- OUT: the atomic PR-first graduation write + tagging (draft-6); the safeguard no-auto-commit assertion (draft-6); end-to-end fixtures (draft-8).

## Done Definitions

- The Graduation Phase reads all bugs tagged negative-example and lacking any promoted-to-standard:* tag via a single ticket-CLI query ← Satisfies: sc-5
- Frequency-floor candidates require >=3 examples sharing a bug_type_slug with distinct root-cause fingerprints, and a group whose examples are >=80% missed_signal_summary similar is collapsed to a single signal rather than counted as N ← Satisfies: sc-5
- Cross-slug candidates are surfaced only via a single falsifiable predicate naming a specific input state or code path and an expected observable outcome, and theme-level labels are not surfaced ← Satisfies: sc-5
- Each surfaced candidate carries a 4-field draft rule (rule_statement, rationale, anti_pattern_example, correct_pattern_example), at least 3 evidence_citations with quoted missed_signal_summary, and explicit provenance ← Satisfies: sc-5
- A candidate overlapping an existing behavioral-testing-standard.md rule is blocked from surfacing unless revised-as-modification or justified-as-distinct ← Satisfies: sc-5
- On user acceptance the sycophancy gate blocks PR drafting and marks the candidate challenged-rejected when the distinct-coverage answer is empty or merely restates the rule ← Satisfies: sc-5
- The Graduation Phase emits RETRO_TELEMETRY with the specified counter fields on completion ← Satisfies: sc-5
- The RETRO_TELEMETRY counters examples_extracted_since_last_retro and examples_skipped_count count only NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE and SKIP_RECORD comments whose creation timestamp is after the since-last-retro watermark, where the watermark is read from the prior RETRO_TELEMETRY artifact timestamp or a stored last-retro cursor ← Satisfies: sc-5
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-5

## Considerations

- [Dependency] EXTERNAL BLOCKER: pre-draft conflict check reads behavioral-testing-standard.md structure established by a03c-d55e; slug grouping uses 4911-c7ba taxonomy.
- [Risk] Cross-slug over-clustering residual is opus self-assessment; the single-falsifiable-predicate constraint and sycophancy gate are the spec mitigations — assert both with THEME-only-rejection and empty-answer fixtures.
- [CrossStory] The RETRO_TELEMETRY counters examples_extracted_since_last_retro and examples_skipped_count (SC9(l)) count NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE and SKIP_RECORD comments produced by draft-2 Phase G. Establish a 'since last retro' watermark mechanism (read the prior RETRO_TELEMETRY artifact/comment timestamp, or a stored last-retro cursor) and count only comments created after it; rely on the creation timestamp draft-2 stamps on those comments.
- [CrossEpic] detected_by candidate-weighting signal lands with a34c-b345 observability epic; design the query so detected_by:<channel> filtering can be added without rework, but do not depend on it.
- [Operational] SC5 sycophancy-gate firing is captured in-session per the epic operational-constraints table.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want /dso:retro to surface graduation candidates from the negative-example corpus via frequency and cross-slug-predicate triggers with a sycophancy gate, so recurring lessons become draft universal rules
